{{External|rs|rsc=Rune Mace}} {{Infobox Item |name = Rune mace |image = [[File:Rune mace.png]] |release = [[26 July]] [[2001]] |update = Runescape updated (26 July 2001) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A spiky mace. |value = 14400 |weight = 1.814 |exchange = Yes |id = 1432 }} [[File:Rune mace detail.png|left|120px]] A '''rune mace''' is a [[mace]] made of [[runite equipment|runite]]. It requires 40 [[Attack]]. It can be made at level 87 [[Smithing]] using one [[Rune bar]]. It is currently the sixth-strongest mace in the game, surpassed by the [[Void knight mace]], [[Barronite mace]], [[Dragon mace]], [[Tzhaar-ket-em]], and the [[Inquisitor's mace]]. It is the second strongest [[free-to-play]] mace, behind the [[Barronite mace]] which has a higher crush and strength bonus, but a lower prayer bonus. The rune mace can be purchased from [[Scavvo's Rune Store]] in the [[Champions' Guild]] for a price of {{NoCoins|14400|c}} after obtaining 32 [[quest points]]. It can also be purchased from [[Spike's Spikes]] in [[Outer Fortis]] for {{NoCoins|18720|c}}, only requiring access to [[Varlamore]]. The rune mace can be combined with [[Scurrius' spine]] on an anvil using a hammer to create the [[bone mace]], requiring 35 [[Smithing]].
